title: How Specification Explicitness Shapes Failure in LLM-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.20195v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When LLMs turn requirements into code, every underspecified constraint becomes behavior that the model must decide during generation. We test when specifications move beyond structure and begin to control generated behavior. In a controlled experiment, 72 participants implemented and revised Python tasks with an LLM under three levels of specification explicitness. The results show a clear break between lightweight structure and explicit behavioral obligations. Lightweight structure reduced hidden-test failures by only 8.7%. Requiring participants to specify constraints, invariants, negative requirements, edge cases, tie-breaking rules, and exception handling cut failures by 47.2% and reduced the number of distinct failure modes by 20.5%. The largest drops were in failure modes tied to implicit obligations. Invariant violations fell by 66.1%, and unsupported assumptions fell by 59.5%. translated_title: 规约明确程度如何塑造大语言模型生成代码中的失败
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型（LLM）将需求转化为代码时，每一个未被明确规定的约束都会变成模型必须在生成过程中自行决定的行为。我们测试了规约在何时超越结构层面、开始控制生成代码的实际行为。在一项受控实验中，72名参与者在三种规约明确性水平下使用LLM实现和修改Python任务。结果显示，轻量级结构与明确的行为义务之间存在清晰分界：轻量级结构仅将隐藏测试失败减少了8.7%；而要求参与者明确指定约束、不变量、否定性需求、边界情况、平局裁决规则和异常处理，则将失败减少了47.2%，并将不同失败模式的数量减少了20.5%。降幅最大的是与隐含义务相关的失败模式：不变量违例下降了66.1%，不支持的假设下降了59.5%。在需求变更后，具有明确……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过72人参与的受控实验发现，轻量级结构规约对减少LLM生成代码的失败作用有限（仅8.7%），而明确写出约束、不变量、否定性需求、边界情况等行为义务可将失败减少47.2%，其中与隐含义务相关的失败模式降幅最大。
en_tdlr: A controlled experiment with 72 participants shows that lightweight structural specification only reduces failures in LLM-generated code by 8.7%, while explicitly specifying behavioral obligations such as constraints, invariants, negative requirements, and edge cases cuts failures by 47.2%, with the largest reductions in failure modes tied to implicit obligations.
